{"task": {"id": "I_kwDONElfw88AAAABfGTpdA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlV6PzhIma2c", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlV6P", "number": 120, "title": "Prevent post-merge verification from causing review/fix/publication loops", "body": "## Problem

ProjectWeave publication adds `Closes #N`, while its merge/close stages close the source Issue. A repository rule that requires removing that reference or keeping an implemented Issue open solely until post-merge verification finishes makes review and publication undo each other. This caused five identical Review -> Fix -> Publish -> Review rounds for takahirox/my-audio-to-text#373.

The owner has explicitly selected this lifecycle: complete the required implementation and pre-merge acceptance, merge and close the original Issue, then perform required post-merge verification. If verification reveals a problem, create a new linked Issue instead of keeping or reopening the original Issue for that follow-up.

## Expected outcome

Make this lifecycle and loop prevention explicit and consistent in this repository's existing development/review guidance and Issue/PR templates. Reuse existing guidance and change only what is missing or contradictory; do not introduce a new policy subsystem.

- Preserve the normal `Closes #N` reference for a fully implemented Issue whose applicable mandatory pre-merge checks are satisfied. Review must not request removing it, keep the source Issue open, or withhold approval solely because a post-merge-only check is pending.
- Close the original Issue after successful merge, then perform genuinely required post-merge checks and record accurate evidence in the merged PR, closed Issue, or linked validation report.
- When an actual defect is found, register a new Issue with reproduction steps, affected revision, expected/actual behavior and links to the original Issue/PR. Check for an existing equivalent Issue first. Do not reopen the original Issue solely for post-merge follow-up.
- Report unperformed, pending or environment-blocked checks honestly; Issue closure does not claim they passed. An unavailable test environment alone is not evidence of a product defect.
- Pending post-merge-only verification does not make an otherwise complete implementation partial. Actual missing implementation, mandatory pre-merge tests, required protections and genuinely necessary pre-merge human acceptance remain blockers. Intentional partial implementation must still state its remaining scope and must not automatically close the parent Issue.
- Require post-merge verification only when the actual change needs it. Do not add routine manual approval, physical-device, heavyweight-model-download or deployment gates to documentation work.
- Review relevant current guides/templates for conflicting closure instructions. Preserve historical test outcomes and evidence; explain that the current lifecycle supersedes older instructions to keep an implemented Issue open solely for post-merge verification, without rewriting historical results.

## Scope

Documentation and template changes only. Do not change application behavior, models, execution engines, ProjectWeave/GitWeave runtime code, repository protections, CI/deployment workflows or existing verification requirements. Do not bypass required checks or reviews.

## Pre-merge acceptance criteria

- [ ] Development and review guidance explicitly describe the lifecycle above and the publication/review loop to avoid.
- [ ] Applicable Issue/PR templates agree with that guidance, without redundant policy duplication.
- [ ] Actual partial work and missing pre-merge acceptance remain distinct from pending post-merge-only verification.
- [ ] Evidence recording and new linked Issues for discovered problems are documented.
- [ ] Relevant Markdown structure, relative links/anchors, consistency and `git diff --check` pass. Application test suites and live deployments/model runs are unnecessary solely for these documentation edits.

## Required post-merge verification

None for this documentation/template change. This Issue defines how future changes' genuinely required post-merge verification is handled; it does not require performing those future checks now.

## Authorization and limits

The owner explicitly requested a task-labeled Issue in every managed repository except snes-roms. Complete this work through the existing repository/ProjectWeave workflow. Never redeem Usage Limit reset tickets, buy allowance or change models/providers to evade a usage limit. Stop allowance-consuming work and report a limit without automatic retries.
